resources.name: Demographics
resources.description: Patient demographic and cohort information, including birth year, race, ethnicity, sex, geographic area, and the diagnosis cohort the patient belongs to. Scope: Seattle data, the 93 radiant-cohort patients treated at Seattle Children's Hospital. Requests about the Seattle data or Seattle patients are answered from the line-level tables (Patient, Demographics, Event, Medical Therapy, Radiation, Surgery, Treatment Summary); requests about the full, all, Cumulus or Radiant data from the Efs and Os cubes.

fields.name: organization_name
fields.description: Name of the institution that contributed the patient's data to this release.

fields.name: research_id
fields.description: De-identified patient research identifier.

fields.name: given_name
fields.description: De-identification placeholder for the patient's first name; contains no real name information.

fields.name: family_name
fields.description: De-identification placeholder for the patient's last name; contains no real name information.

fields.name: birth_year
fields.description: Patient's year of birth. Month and day are removed for de-identification.

fields.name: race
fields.description: Patient's race as reported by the contributing institution.

fields.name: ethnicity
fields.description: Patient's ethnicity as reported by the contributing institution.

fields.name: gender
fields.description: Patient's administrative sex as recorded by the contributing institution.

fields.name: address_postal_code
fields.description: Patient's residential ZIP code, partially masked for de-identification.

fields.name: diagnosis_type_cohort
fields.description: The patient's primary diagnosis group used to define the cohort for this release.

resources.name: Event
resources.description: Disease events across the patient's cancer journey, including initial diagnosis, progression, recurrence, second malignancy, and death, with the diagnosis, tumor location, and metastasis status recorded at each event. Scope: Seattle data, the 93 radiant-cohort patients treated at Seattle Children's Hospital. Requests about the Seattle data or Seattle patients are answered from the line-level tables (Patient, Demographics, Event, Medical Therapy, Radiation, Surgery, Treatment Summary); requests about the full, all, Cumulus or Radiant data from the Efs and Os cubes.

fields.name: organization_name
fields.description: Name of the institution that contributed the patient's data to this release.

fields.name: research_id
fields.description: De-identified patient research identifier.

fields.name: event_type
fields.description: The type of diagnosis-related event determined via surgery, imaging, or clinical observation.

fields.name: age_at_event_days
fields.description: Patient age in days at the diagnosis-related event. A value of -1 indicates an unknown date.

fields.name: metastasis
fields.description: Whether metastatic disease was present at the time of the event.

fields.name: metastasis_location
fields.description: The site of the metastasis.

fields.name: metastasis_location_other
fields.description: Free-text value supplied when the coded metastasis_location does not cover the finding (the site of the metastasis).

fields.name: cns_diagnosis_category
fields.description: The diagnosis at the time of the event (broad diagnosis category).

fields.name: cns_integrated_diagnosis
fields.description: The diagnosis at the time of the event (WHO integrated histologic plus molecular diagnosis). A more specific molecular subtype from OpenPedCan replaces the CBTN value in two cases: where CBTN recorded only a non-specific "NOS or NEC" value, and where CBTN recorded "Medulloblastoma, non-WNT/non-SHH" and OpenPedCan identified Group 3 or Group 4 (which are non-WNT/non-SHH subtypes, so this narrows the diagnosis rather than contradicting it). cns_integrated_diagnosis_source records which source won.

fields.name: cns_integrated_diagnosis_source
fields.description: Which source supplied cns_integrated_diagnosis on this row: 'CBTN' where the value is as CBTN recorded it, or 'OpenPedCan' where a more specific molecular subtype from openpedcan_histologies_annotated replaced it, matched on the event's biospecimen sample ID. OpenPedCan wins in two cases: a non-specific CBTN "NOS or NEC" value, and a CBTN "Medulloblastoma, non-WNT/non-SHH" value that OpenPedCan narrows to Group 3 or Group 4.

fields.name: tumor_locations
fields.description: The anatomical site of the tumor.

fields.name: tumor_location_other
fields.description: Free-text value supplied when the coded tumor_locations does not cover the finding (the anatomical site of the tumor).

resources.name: Efs
resources.title: Patients (Cumulus)
resources.description: Event-free survival cube, full cohort: ATRT and Medulloblastoma (CBTN PCX 30 V6, 2026-10-21 revised delivery), durations in months. Pre-aggregated marginal cube (Presto GROUP BY CUBE, 64 grouping sets, 24,056 rows): each row counts patients over its non-null dimensions; null means the dimension is rolled up, never missing data. Missing data is a literal 'Not Reported' / 'Not Applicable' string, or -1 for durations. 970 patients, 397 events. Every patient in the PCX 30 patient table; none excluded. Use event_free_survival_months with efs_status for survival curves. No small-cell suppression (17,619 rows have cnt = 1). Scope: full data (also called all, Cumulus or Radiant data), all 970 patients across every site. Requests about the full, all, Cumulus or Radiant data are answered from the Efs and Os cubes; requests about the Seattle data or Seattle patients from the line-level tables.

fields.name: cnt
fields.title: Patient count
fields.description: Count of distinct patients in the cell (COUNT(DISTINCT research_id)). Within any grouping set the counts sum to the cohort (970); do not sum overlapping cube cells.

fields.name: event_free_survival_months
fields.description: Time from initial diagnosis to the first progression, recurrence, second malignancy or death; if none, to the most recent vital status, in whole months: floor(days / 30.4375), where 30.4375 = 365.25 / 12. 0 means under one month of follow-up, not missing. 120 means 120 months (10 years) or more. -1 means the duration is unknown (no initial diagnosis date, no vital-status date, or an end date before diagnosis); exclude it from survival curves. Read with efs_status. Null when the row aggregates over (rolls up) this dimension.

fields.name: efs_status
fields.description: Whether the EFS clock stopped on an event. 'event' = first progression, recurrence, second malignancy or death observed; 'event-free' = none of these, censored at most recent vital status. Conventional EFS: death without a prior event counts as an event (unlike CBTN's workbook definition, which censors those deaths). Null when the row aggregates over (rolls up) this dimension.

fields.name: diagnosis
fields.description: Patient's diagnosis cohort: CBTN demographics.diagnosis_type_cohort as delivered; if absent, the CNS diagnosis category of the patient's Initial CNS Tumor event (else earliest event). Levels: ATRT, Medulloblastoma. Filter to one value for a single-diagnosis view. Null when the row aggregates over (rolls up) this dimension.

fields.name: protocol_name_and_arm
fields.description: protocol_name_and_arm of the patient's first medical-therapy regimen, ordered by regimen start (ties and undated regimens fall back to the order in CBTN's table). Taken from any point after diagnosis, not limited to the initial treatment window. CBTN labels as delivered; a protocol without an arm suffix (e.g. 'ACNS0331') means the arm was not recorded. 'Not Applicable' = no medical-therapy record; 'Not Reported' = regimen recorded, protocol not recorded; 'Other' = CBTN's label for a protocol outside its list. Because this is the first regimen at any time, a regimen started only after relapse can appear for a patient with no initial chemotherapy. Null when the row aggregates over (rolls up) this dimension.

fields.name: subtype
fields.description: Molecular subtype at initial diagnosis, from cns_integrated_diagnosis. Every value carries its diagnosis as a prefix ('MB-' or 'ATRT-'), so subtypes never pool across diagnoses when diagnosis is rolled up. Medulloblastoma: refined with OpenPedCan molecular subtype where CBTN supplied it; SHH TP53-wildtype and SHH TP53-mutant are pooled as 'MB-SHH'. ATRT: CBTN label as delivered, no refinement. Levels: MB-Group 3, MB-Group 4, MB-non-WNT/non-SHH, MB-NOS/NEC, MB-SHH, MB-WNT, ATRT-MYC, ATRT-NOS/NEC, ATRT-SHH, ATRT-TYR. 'MB-NOS/NEC' and 'ATRT-NOS/NEC' = no molecular subtype recorded; 'MB-non-WNT/non-SHH' = Group 3 or 4 not resolved further. Null when the row aggregates over (rolls up) this dimension.

fields.name: site
fields.description: CBTN organization_name as delivered (the treating organization on the patient's event records). Not grouped by consent or RADIANT status. 'CBTN Non-Consortium Member' is a CBTN-supplied label for patients from organizations outside the consortium. Null when the row aggregates over (rolls up) this dimension.

resources.name: Os
resources.description: Overall survival cube, full cohort: ATRT and Medulloblastoma (CBTN PCX 30 V6, 2026-10-21 revised delivery), durations in months. Scope: full data (also called all, Cumulus or Radiant data), all 970 patients across every site.
